rationale: The replication successfully reproduces the core SODW mean-field mechanism: the self-consistent gap equation yields Δ₀≈6.2 meV (within the paper's 5–10 meV range) and Tₕ≈17.9 K (remarkably close to experimental 17.5 K), with interaction scale V_c~0.3 eV in the correct order. However, integrated Fermi-surface quantities—the ~40% spectral-weight loss and ~24% entropy release that are central experimental signatures—are underreproduced by roughly an order of magnitude (~6% and ~0.6% respectively), and the Zeeman critical field overshoots 3×. These discrepancies stem from using a simplified nested model band rather than the paper's DFT-derived Fermi surface, which was explicitly scoped out. The qualitative SODW physics is confirmed but quantitative thermodynamic predictions require the realistic band structure.
